'''Tabala Zo''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who lived during the era of the [[New Republic Era|New Republic]] and the subsequent [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. Zo joined the Resistance; and was stationed at their [[D'Qar]] [[Resistance base|headquarters]]. Serving under [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], a veteran of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and leader of the Resistance, she worked as an operations [[controller]] in [[Fleet Command (Resistance)|Fleet Command]]. During the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]], she monitored the firing cycle of the First Order's primary weapon.<ref name="Episode VII" />

After the conclusion of the [[Battle of Exegol]], Zo celebrated the end of the First Order at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on [[Ajan Kloss]], where she was seen hugging another member of the Resistance.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tabala Zo was portrayed by [[Philicia Saunders]] in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="Episode VII" /> She reprised the role in the [[2019]] sequel [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]].
